title: story.state
description: The player's blockade-relevant state: full on join, then deltas.

bikeKind.description: BIKE_PLAN D10: the bike the hidden player rides (player.state.bikeKind), sent with bike in a full state or a delta that changes it; the server keeps it for the bike entity's look. Optional.

trick.description: BIKE_PLAN D6: the Acro bike's pose (player.state.trick), relayed to the bike entity. Optional.

run.description: FA8 item 7 (D4): the hidden player is running (player.state.run); the server gives it the running speed. Optional; absent in a full state: not running.

forced.description: WATER_AND_BRIDGES_PLAN D4: the client walks the player in a forced move (a waterfall climbed or descended); a waterfall's foot wall opens for it. Optional; absent in a full state: no forced move.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
